svg.title: Hey, I'm Aditya.
svg.desc: I'm a computer science student who enjoys working on problems that don't have obvious solutions. Most of my projects begin with a question about how an existing system could work differently or be built better. I'm interested in software architecture, machine learning and algorithmic problem-solving. From binary search trees and graph traversal to Monte Carlo methods and optimization, I enjoy exploring the ideas behind the software I build. NODUS: Investigating dependencies across enterprise systems.; PRAMAN: Reconciling conflicting land records.; A.P.E.X: Adapting training schedules to changing constraints.
